text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki,
mesmerized the crowd with a fantastic run――!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After the NHK Mile Cup ended—the stands were filled with a buzz, utterly captivated by the miracle they had just witnessed.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member A
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! That turned out surprisingly
exciting! Thank goodness~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member B
text_block_list.text:
See, I knew it! Miss Fuji can
make anything look absolutely captivating!

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "...'If we shine, it will be the greatest race ever'... huh."

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
............
Maybe I'll watch for just a little longer...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's great!
It looks like everyone really enjoyed it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Above all, she came to watch, too.
She didn't look upset. That was a relief.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Still... that might not be enough to forge a path forward.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A fierce battle that made you forget to breathe, shocking developments,
and a thrilling climax.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I have to leave behind enough inspiration
on this path to match all that!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. The next race is
the Mile Championship, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Mile Championship. The autumn decider for the mile crown,
bringing together Senior Class runners as well. If one seeks
to master the mile distance, it cannot be missed.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's a wonderful race where the strongest
sprint and mile Umamusume gather.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If you're utterly no match for them,
there's no way an exciting race could ever come of it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I promised to forge a path forward.
Let's get stronger this summer, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Target race changed to the Mile Championship.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading toward the Mile CS where formidable rivals await,
the days of racing through summer have begun!
